subject: Collaboration between our CLN2 community and Taylor's Tale
body:
Dear Taylor's Tale team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group supporting families affected by CLN2 (Ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 2). I'm reaching out to introduce our group and explore whether there might be opportunities to connect.

A paper reports that Taylor's Tale catalyzed a research project and funded early research at UNC Chapel Hill on CLN2, alongside The Saoirse Foundation, Hayden's Batten Disease Foundation, and BDSRA [E8e670ee]. Given this history of supporting CLN2 research, I believe our communities have a shared interest in advancing understanding of this disease.

I would love to learn more about your current work and see if there are ways our organizations could support one another going forward. Would you be open to a brief introductory call in the coming weeks, just to share updates and explore potential synergies?

Thank you for all the work you do for families facing Batten disease. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader, CLN2 Family Support

Sources:
[E8e670ee] https://www.taylorstale.org/rare-disease/about-batten-disease/
